raw_response:
My beans plot is small, only 0.42 hectares, and I keep it separate from my maize where the FISP fertilizer coupon goes. Beans fix their own nitrogen so I do not waste the little chemical fertilizer I have on them — I will put some manure from my goats and chickens instead. I will plant seed I saved from last season because improved bean seed is hard to find and costly here in Dedza, and I cannot afford pesticides. My daughter and I will weed by hand twice, and I may ask a neighbour for one or two days of help at planting.
